reconstruction.scope: Connected Brooklyn Museum exterior: exact parent/part footprint, long pale Beaux-Arts wings and rear ranges, picture-led open rear court, six-column Ionic portico/recessed upper doorway, supported triangular pediment and abstract relief/roof ornament, square attic and shallow stone dome, flat roof/skylights and the curved stepped glass entrance pavilion. Pavilion has a real central recessed lower door, soffit and threshold; glass is an opaque reflected exterior proxy. Outer terraced landscape, fountains, garden collections, temporary exhibition banners, freestanding art, furnished rooms and copied sculpture/inscriptions remain outside this model. Two short exterior treads bridge the approximate 0.4m native threshold grade.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Medium-fi picture-led exterior. The single unqualified 50m map height is not used as a surveyed measurement. Working main roof 26m, upper portico floor 5.1m, six tapered Ionic columns to22.8m, pediment peak30m, square attic31.2m and shallow stone dome to39m above floor. Pavilion uses five descending concentric glass-roof bands approximately6.4..4.4m above floor. Rear court dimensions/placement, heights, bay counts, hidden faces, roof equipment, statue/relief abstractions and roof junctions are approximate. Two current ordinary pictures establish main colors/silhouette; no exhibition banners, copied artworks, furnished galleries or costly transparent/refraction materials. The two reconstructed 0.18m exterior treads are a working fit to the original standard approach, not surveyed historic steps.
reconstruction.terrainBasis: Qualified approximate native exterior fit on original Protomaps20261020/Mapzen 201x201 / 6m ground. Open front provider[0,36] supplies 48.12656157087435m datum.
